561641.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
561641.Flavor Text: She’d seen what the ink could do for other glimmers. What could it do for her?

561642.Flavor Text: “The secret room should be right here! Ach, I cannot believe I paid a whole penny for this map.”

561646.Description: [My Greatest Performance] Whenever this character quests, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an action card with cost 6 or less and play it for free. Put the rest in your discard.

561648.Description: [Taxes Never Fail Me] Whenever you play an item, this character gets +2 Strength this turn.
561648.Flavor Text: “Of course I’m on the list. Check under ‘PJ.’”

561649.Description: [Cake Catapult] When you play this character, chosen character gets -2 Strength this turn.
561649.Flavor Text: This puts the Frosting Flinger 2000 to shame.

561650.Description: [Baffling Mystery] When you play this character, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
561650.Flavor Text: “There’s just gotta be one of those chromi-thingies around here somewhere!”

561651.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Ushered into the Party] When you play this character, your other characters gain Ward until the start of your next turn.

561652.Description: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
561652.Flavor Text: “We must repair the Illuminary before it’s too late. And we’ll need these devices, these chromicons, to fix it.”

561653.Description: Put chosen item or location into its player's inkwell facedown and exerted.
561653.Flavor Text:
Fauna: “Oh my! We dropped some...”
Merryweather: “You mean you dropped some!”

561848.Description: Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
561848.Flavor Text: Underestimating him is a recipe for disaster.

561850.Description: Chosen character gains Resist +1 and Evasive this turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1. They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

561851.Description: [Deflect] Banish this item — Chosen character gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

561853.Description: [Mountain Defense] During your turn, the first time you move a character here, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character. If the moved character is a Knight, deal 2 damage instead.

561946.Description: [You've Got to Pay to Play] Whenever this character quests, chosen opposing character gets -1 Strength until the start of your next turn.
561946.Flavor Text: "I’ll take whatever you’ve got . . . as long as it’s got sugar in it."

561947.Description: Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.)
561947.Flavor Text: "Good evening, Lorcana! We’re here tonight to celebrate what’s possible when we stand together as one."

561948.Description: [If It Pleases the Lady] When you play this character, chosen opposing character gets -5 Strength until the start of your next turn.
561948.Flavor Text: "And who might you be, my knight and champion?"

561949.Description: [Patch Them Up] Whenever this character quests, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.
561949.Flavor Text: "Oh my! Is that part of the Illuminary? I have to go help!

561950.Description:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Maleficent.)
[Listen Well, All of You] When you play this character, for each of your characters named Maleficent in play, return a chosen opposing character, item, or location with cost 3 or less to their player's hand.

561951.Description: [Give Me Time to Think] When you play this character and when he leaves play, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck and the other on the bottom.

561952.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Anna.)
[Exceptional Power] When you play this character, exert all opposing characters.

561953.Description: [Phenomenal Showman] While this character is exerted, opposing characters can't ready at the start of their turn.
561953.Flavor Text: "Keep your eyes on me, folks! It's time for a little prestidigitation!"

561954.Description: [Growing Powers] When you play this character, each opponent chooses and exerts one of their ready characters.
561954.Flavor Text: "Okay, I can totally move small stuff. I need something bigger . . . Where's Kristoff's sled?"

561955.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Easy Pickings] While challenging a damaged character, this character gets +2 Strength.

561956.Description: [Trick Shot] When you play this character, if an opponent has a damaged character in play, gain 1 lore.
561956.Flavor Text: "For a second there, I thought this might be a real challenge."

561957.Flavor Text: He won’t turn down a quick bite before dinner.

561958.Description:
[Slayer of Dragons] When you play this character, banish chosen opposing Dragon character.
[Pressing the Advantage] Whenever he challenges a damaged character, ready this character after the challenge.

561959.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Clarabelle.)
[Keep in Step] At the end of your turn, if chosen opponent has more cards in their hand than you, you may draw cards until you have the same number.

561960.Description: [Butterfingers] When you play this character, you may pay 2 Ink to banish chosen item.

561961.Description: [Royally Big Rewards] At the end of your turn, if you have any characters in play with 5 Strength or more, gain 2 lore. If you have any in play with 10 Strength or more, gain 5 lore instead.
561961.Flavor Text: It's easy to get carried away when it comes to tug-of-war.

561962.Description: [Long Live the King] When you play this character, you may banish chosen character named Mufasa.
561962.Flavor Text: The second Rule of Villainy: Never settle for second place.

561963.Description: [Scram!] When you play this character, if you have another character named Pete in play, you may banish chosen opposing character.

561964.Description: Ready chosen character of yours. They can't quest for the rest of this turn. If a Villain character is chosen, gain 1 lore.

561965.Description: [Vile Concoction] 1 Ink, Banish this item — Chosen character gets +3 Strength this turn. If a Villain character is chosen, they get +4 Strength instead.

561966.Description: [Long Live the King!] Your characters named Arthur gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
561966.Flavor Text: "A little rest and relaxation will do wonders for your health, boy."

561967.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named The Queen.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Reflections of Vanity] For each other character named The Queen you have in play, this character gets +1 Lore.

561968.Description:
[Every Little Bit Helps] For each item you have in play, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character.
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)

561969.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Gatherer of the Wicked] When you play this character, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of character cards named The Queen and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

561970.Description:
(A character with cost 2 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Remove up to 2 damage from any number of chosen characters.
561970.Flavor Text:
Ever just as sure
As the sun will rise

561971.Description: Put chosen character of yours into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

561972.Description:
[I Don't Have Any Other Choice] For each opposing character banished in a challenge this turn, you pay 2 Ink less to play this character.
Resist +3 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 3.)

561973.Flavor Text: "Well, by Jove. Don’t just stand there. Raise a glass to my son Kay . . . and may we be rid of the trickster wizard Marvin, or whatever his blasted name was."

561974.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Simba.)
[Fearsome Roar] When you play this character, you may banish chosen item or location.

561975.Description: [Blow the Whistle] When you play this character, opponents can't play actions until the start of your next turn.
561975.Flavor Text: "It ain’t cheatin’ if you’re the one makin' the rules."

561976.Description: Banish any number of your items, then draw a card for each item banished this way.

561977.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Archimedes.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 Strength.)

561978.Description: [There's No One I'd Rather Be Than Me] Villain characters gain "[Exert], 3 Ink - Play a character with the same name as this character for free" while here.

561979.Description: Play a character card with cost 5 or less from your discard for free.

561980.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Life's Not Fair, Is It?] Whenever one of your characters challenges a damaged character, you may draw a card.

561981.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Arthur.)
[Knighted by the King] When you play this character, chosen character gains Challenger +2 and Resist +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 Strength while challenging. Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

561983.Description:
(A character with cost 4 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Shuffle chosen character, item or location into their player's deck. That player draws 2 cards.

561984.Description: [My Greatest Performance] Whenever this character quests, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an action card with cost 6 or less and play it for free. Put the rest in your discard.

561991.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Clarabelle.)
[Keep in Step] At the end of your turn, if chosen opponent has more cards in their hand than you, you may draw cards until you have the same number.

561992.Description:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Vanellope von Schweetz.)
[I Hereby Decree] Whenever you play another Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 Strength until the start of your next turn.

561993.Description:
Singer 6 (This character counts as cost 6 to sing songs.)
[It's Beautiful, No?] When you play this character, you may play a song with cost 6 or less for free.

561994.Description:
[Clear the Path] For each exerted character opponents have in play, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character.
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

561995.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named King Candy.)
[Changing the Code] When you play this character, you may draw 2 cards, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.

562000.Description: [Misfit's Revelry] While you have a damaged character here, this location gets +2 Lore.

562007.Description: [Natural Leader] This character gains Resist +1 for each other Knight character you have in play. (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1 for each other Knight.)

562021.Description:
[A Delicate Balance] When you play this character, exert all cards in your inkwell, then return 2 cards at random from your inkwell to your hand.
[Everything the Light Touches] Whenever this character quests, ready all cards in your inkwell.
